svg.title: Zero-trust AKS platform architecture
svg.desc: A private AKS cluster and three PaaS services (Azure SQL Ledger, Storage, Key Vault) inside one VNet, reachable only through Private Endpoints. Operators and CI reach the cluster through Azure Resource Manager with az aks command invoke; there is no network path to the API server. Egress goes out through a NAT gateway.
